column7: #3277 follow-up: a panic after the verdict on the MFA step-up (MarkTOTPStepUsed, CreateMFAStepUpGrant), impersonation start (CreateSession), the MFA challenge write (/auth/login, setup consume) and every post-token step of /auth/setup/consume answered the Recovery 500 instead of the error kind's answer. Now answered like the error, commit-aware (no session/impersonation session/grant left usable; a landed step-up grant is consumed, also for the error kind). Also: server/http/handlers TestConsumeSetup_PostVerdictPanicAnsweredLikeItsError, TestMFAStepUp_PostVerdictFaultIsIdenticalToAWrongCode, TestLogin_CreateMFAChallengeFaultCostsTheSameAsAWrongPassword; internal/core TestVerifyMFAStepUp_GrantWriteFailureLeavesNoElevation.
